blocks.text: DNA har jaandaar cell ke nucleus mein hai. Yeh proteins banane ka code shuda mansooba, ya naqsha, hai jo zindagi ke liye zaroori hain; har khaas protein aik khaas gene, DNA ke aik hisse, se banta hai. DNA tamam jaandaron ki nashonuma, kaam, barhne aur tolid ki jeneyati hidayaat rakhta hai. Is ka double helix apne chaar bases ki tarteeb mein maloomat jama karta aur protein ki tayyari ke liye mo'assar aur durust taur par aage deta hai.

Genes bari units, chromosomes, mein munazzam hain; insaan walidain se 23 jore paate hain. Taqreeban har cell mein 23 joron ka poora set hota hai, lekin har qism ka cell apne kuch hi genes use karta hai: jo cell khoon ka surkh cell banega woh haemoglobin ka gene chalu aur keratin ka gene band rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch jure daire, har aik pichhle ka qareebi manzar: nucleus wala cell (genome, cell ke nucleus mein); chromosome (insaani cell mein 23 jore); chromosome ka hissa jis mein aik gene nishaan zada (chromosome ka hissa jo aik protein banata); DNA double helix (shakar-phosphate zanjeer se jure bases ki polymer zanjeerein); aur reerh par teen bases G, T, A (codon, teen bases ka group jo aik khaas amino acid ka code hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 27.14: DNA; genome se codon tak (kitab ki Figure 27.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1953 mein James Watson aur Francis Crick ne dikhaya ke DNA do polynucleotide zanjeeron par mushtamil hai. Har zanjeer daen haath ka helix banati aur dono zanjeerein aik doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banati hain. Zanjeerein aik jaisi nahi balke takmeeli (complementary) hain, aur ulti simton mein chalti hain: aik ka 3' sira doosri ke 5' sire ke saamne hai. Har zanjeer ki shakar-phosphate reerh hai jis se bases seedhe zaviye par nikalte aur doosri zanjeer ke bases se kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure hain. Adenine (A) hamesha thymine (T) ke saamne aur guanine (G) cytosine (C) ke saamne hai; A-T jore mein do aur G-C jore mein teen hydrogen bonds hain.

blocks.alt: Baen, base pairing: do khari shakar-phosphate reerhon (backbones) ke darmiyan aath jore, A-T, C-G, G-C, G-C, T-A, T-A, C-G, G-C; A-T do tooti lakeeron (hydrogen bonds) se aur G-C teen se jure. Daen, double helix: do reerh ke feete aik doosre ke gird lipte, darmiyan rangeen base jore.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.15: DNA ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tooti lakeerein hydrogen bonds hain: A aur T ke darmiyan do, G aur C ke darmiyan teen. Base pairing wali seedhi seerhi hi mud kar double helix banti hai: dono kinare shakar-phosphate reerh hain aur darmiyan ki pattiyan base jore.

Genes DNA ke woh khaas hisse hain jo jeneyati maloomat rakhte aur cell ko khaas proteins banane ki hidayat dete hain. DNA ka ahem amal apni naqal (self-replication) hai: cell cycle ke dauran DNA copy hota hai, taa ke cell ki taqseem par har naye cell ko jeneyati maadde ka poora set mile. Is tarah jeneyati maloomat aik cell se us ke beti cells aur agli nasal tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt: A-T jore aur G-C jore ko kitne hydrogen bonds jorte hain?
blocks.explanation: A aur T ke darmiyan do; G aur C ke darmiyan teen.

items: DNA: daen haath ke double helix mein do ulti simt ki polynucleotide zanjeerein (Watson aur Crick, 1953).
A-T (2 hydrogen bonds), G-C (3 hydrogen bonds).
Genes proteins ka code; cell taqseem se pehle DNA ki naqal.
